headline: Empirical research on trade, firms, and economic adjustment.
subheadline: I work with product-level trade data, Vietnamese firm panels, econometric models, and machine-learning methods to study how economies and firms respond to change. My long-term goal is to pursue an academic path in mathematical economics and econometrics.
statement: I work from economic questions toward auditable evidence: constructing datasets, testing econometric designs, evaluating predictive systems, and reporting completed results within the limits supported by the data.
